products.name: Langfuse
products.note: Open-source, framework-agnostic LLM observability: tracing, prompt management, evals, datasets; OpenTelemetry-native; acquired by ClickHouse

profile_text.body:
Langfuse is an open-source AI engineering platform designed to help teams build, monitor, and improve large language model applications. The company describes itself as providing tracing, prompt management, evaluations, and analytics dashboards across the full development lifecycle, all within a single platform. According to its site, Langfuse is used by more than 50,000 companies and processes billions of observations per month.

The platform's core function is capturing hierarchical traces of every LLM call, tool invocation, and retrieval step, with filtering by user, session, cost, latency, or custom metadata. Langfuse describes itself as OpenTelemetry-native and framework-agnostic, with integrations listed for a wide range of tools and frameworks including LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LiteLLM, Dify, Langflow, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen, and others. The company positions its platform as built specifically for the scale and verbosity of LLM system outputs, which it contrasts with traditional observability tools.

The held facts note that Langfuse has been acquired by ClickHouse, and ClickHouse also appears among the listed integrations on the Langfuse site. The product is tracked under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category.
